scope: One candidate-only same-resolution wall baseColor refinement. Reuse approved2K source, deterministic1K Lanczos resample and conservative unsharp. No geometry, UV, lighting, normal/ARM or sampler changes.
source_mode: Deterministic postprocessing of the already licensed and reviewed source photograph; no invented texture detail or upscale.

postprocess.rationale: Single conservative subpixel contrast restoration after2:1 downsample. Parameters fixed before rendering; no candidate grid. Inspect halo, moire and moving-camera shimmer before acceptance.

gates: Exactly1024x1024 and zero extra RGBA8 mip residency
Matched actual-renderer close/front/oblique/far/ground/courtyard views at high and low quality
Moving-camera shimmer and normal gameplay before runtime integration
Isolated valid cost comparison; invalid or noisy timing cannot count as performance acceptance
stop_rule: Reject if same1K visual benefit is weak or introduces halo/moire/shimmer. Do not fall back to rejected1536/2K assets, add detail geometry, relax measured gates or claim existing low-FPS issue fixed.
